subject.title: build(deps): bump the production-minor-and-patch group with 9 updates

question: Should maintainers accept this grouped production dependency upgrade as-is, or split/runtime-smoke the higher-risk packages first?
rationale: The patch is dependency-only and green, but it changes several production runtime and rendering dependencies at once, so automation cannot safely own the compatibility decision.

options.title: Accept grouped upgrade
options.body: Merge after maintainer approval, relying on the successful CI, Playwright, CodeQL, secret scanning, and Vercel preview checks for this Dependabot head.

options.title: Split high-risk packages
options.body: Ask for separate updates or extra targeted smoke around Convex, Sharp, Resend, Mermaid, and Shiki before merging production dependency changes.

options.title: Pause this bump
options.body: Leave the PR open until a maintainer has time to review upstream release notes and runtime compatibility for the grouped production packages.

recommendation.title: Accept grouped upgrade
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer approval, relying on the successful CI, Playwright, CodeQL, secret scanning, and Vercel preview checks for this Dependabot head.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the strongest concrete routing signal from current dependency-block blame and CODEOWNERS coverage for affected backend/runtime surfaces.
